en.text:
Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a seeking <arc/>Arc Wave.

Scoring 4 Glaive Projectile Hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next Projectile to apply <arc/>Jolt.

Being <arc/>Amplified decreases the number of Hits required by 1.
